requirement_text.REQ-064: Execute Decision 0006's D2 (docs/migration/decisions/0006-identity-tables-schema-per-tenant.md): drop tenant_id from ten schema-isolated business tables. Full acceptance criteria list is in docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-064 entry -- read it there directly.

task.description:
Independently re-run mix test yourself -- do not trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone. Then confirm every one of REQ-064's seven acceptance criteria (read them directly from docs/requirements.yaml, not from any prior handoff's paraphrase) is satisfied against the actual shipped code/tests.

This run's own history is worth being aware of, not repeating: the test-design gate FAILed once and required one rework cycle -- a test restructure had silently dropped the only assertion covering TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1's own contract, caught because REQ-064's acceptance criteria explicitly required that function stay tested. The fix added a direct unit test to test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs. Confirm that test still exists and still passes as part of your own independent check -- don't assume the earlier gate's finding is still true just because it passed once.

Also this run's security gate (HIGH priority) traced three implementation fixes beyond the original design's scope for cross-tenant safety -- all PASSed. As RELEASE-VALIDATOR your job isn't to re-do that security trace, but do confirm via docs/requirements.yaml and git log that this diff's scope genuinely matches what REQ-064 asked for (D2 only -- the ten-table tenant_id drop -- not touching the four D3 tables or reopening D1's schema-per-tenant isolation choice).

Check docs/requirements.yaml (REQ-064's own status field, currently in_progress) and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml for staleness relative to what actually shipped.

Check whether decision 0006 (docs/migration/decisions/0006-identity-tables-schema-per-tenant.md) needs any update now that BOTH D1 (REQ-063) and D2 (REQ-064) have shipped -- its Status line was updated during REQ-063's own release validation to say 'D1 shipped... D2 not yet executed -- pending REQ-064.' That D2-pending wording is now stale.
acceptance_criteria: mix test independently re-run, real output quoted, matches or explains any discrepancy from the reported 777/777
Each of REQ-064's seven acceptance criteria checked explicitly against the actual code/test files, not against any step's summary
The tenant_provisioning_test.exs coverage fix from the test-design gate's rework confirmed still present and passing
docs/requirements.yaml and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml checked for staleness -- name any drift found
decision 0006's Status line checked for staleness now that both D1 and D2 have shipped, updated if it still says D2 is pending
PASS routes to DOC-UPDATER; FAIL identifies the blocking issue and which agent it routes back to

result.summary:
Independently re-ran mix test (not the TEST-RUNNER report alone): 777 passed (5 properties, 772 tests), 0 failures, no skipped/excluded, matching the reported 777/777 exactly. mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean. Also re-ran test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs in isolation: 18 passed, confirming the test-design gate's rework fix (tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 round-trip test + malformed-schema-name error-path test, describe block at line 129) still exists and still passes -- not merely inferred from the gate's earlier PASS.

Each of REQ-064's seven acceptance criteria checked directly against shipped code/tests (read from docs/requirements.yaml, not any step summary): (1) all ten D2 tables' absence of tenant_id confirmed via information_schema.columns against two independently provisioned real tenant schemas (test/letflow/req064_tenant_id_removal_test.exs, 'information_schema.columns' describe block) -- not by code inspection; (2) all four D3 tables (tenant_schemas, solution_pack_installs, solution_pack_artefact_bases, pack_update_resolutions) confirmed to still carry tenant_id with FK intact via the same information_schema query against 'public', plus the pre-existing 'solution_pack_installs rejects a tenant_id matching no tenants row' FK-rejection test (test/letflow/definitions/pack_update_migration_test.exs:552), re-verified green; (3) promotion_assertion_runs' idempotency contract under the simplified [:idempotency_key] index demonstrated by same-key-same-schema-one-row and same-key-different-schema-separate-row tests; (4) promotion_reviews' plan_digest uniqueness under the simplified [:plan_digest] index demonstrated the same way; (5) grep confirms no lib/ module accesses a live .tenant_id field on any of the ten tables (all remaining tenant_id mentions in lib/letflow/definitions.ex, event_store.ex, promotion.ex, promotion_review_store.ex, identity.ex are historical/explanatory comments noting the column no longer exists), and TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 itself is still defined (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:102) and still tested; (6) every moduledoc that described tenant_id on a dropped-from table updated -- Engine.Task, Engine.Token, EventStore.Event/ArchivedEvent/InstanceProjection all carry a 'No tenant_id column (Decision 0006 D2)' section, Identity.User and Identity.Group both describe the column in past tense with a Decision 0006 D2 citation; grep hits for 'never caller-supplied'/'intra-schema column' outside these are unrelated fields (definitions.ex's `base`, sandbox_pool.ex's `schema_name`) or process_definition.ex's historical R-Co UpdateParams citation, none stale; (7) mix test green, 777/777, no skips, output quoted above.

Diff scope verified against main via git diff --stat and decision 0006's own D2/D3 boundary: touches only the ten D2 tables' schemas/migrations, tenant_provisioning.ex (consumer call-site removal), identity_migration.ex, and the ~25 fallout test files listed in the TEST-DESIGNER handoff -- no touch to the four D3 tables' schemas/migrations, and no reopening of D1's schema-per-tenant :prefix mechanism (Registration/tenant_schemas untouched except the pre-existing conflict_target: :tenant_id, which is D3's Registration struct, correctly left alone).

docs/requirements.yaml (REQ-064 status: in_progress) and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml (last event: REQ-064 'started') checked for staleness -- neither is stale: both correctly reflect that DOC-UPDATER, not RELEASE-VALIDATOR, is the role that flips status to done, and this gate is what unblocks that step. No drift found.

docs/migration/decisions/0006-identity-tables-schema-per-tenant.md's Status line was stale (still read 'D2 not yet executed -- pending REQ-064' despite D2 having just shipped in this run) -- updated to 'decided and fully shipped', naming both D1 (REQ-063) and D2 (REQ-064) with their sign-offs, and clarifying D3/D4's standing status, matching the project's Status-line convention used by 0001-0003.
